tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// chos skyong gi bskang ba bsdus pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub ma thob bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis bsnyen bsgrub bgyis pa'i bsod nams 'di dag gis// 'gro phan phyir sangs rgyas rgyas myur du thob par shog /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod snying thag pas bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shu d+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gyur pa'i mdun gyi dbus su/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor/ g.yas su mgon po bdud kyi spu gri rje blon/ gza' bdud dug gi spu gri/ gza' dang gdong mo/ lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi bka' sdod pa dang*/ zhing skyong se ge'i gdong pa can yab yum las mdzad 'khod pas gral rim pa bzhin 'dod chags kyi mgon po cig car dmar po dregs pa'i tshogs dang*/ dge bsnyen snyo kha'i klu btsan dur khrod kyi bdag mo la sogs pa'i 'bangs kyis 'khor yug tu byas pa/ g.yon phyogs su rim pa ltar 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug dud pa'i sol ba ma/ 'khor nag mo 'bum sdes bskor ba dang*/ bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma la sogs pa'i bran g.yog mang po can dang*/ bod yul lhan cig skyes ma rdo rje g.yu'i sgron ma/ zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma 'bum gyis bskor zhing shan+ti ro gzan ma gnas pa'i dam tshig gi 'khor lo rnams kyi mi shigs pa'i srog gi sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor la badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

spos sna tshogs sha chen dang bsres pa bsreg rnga sil dang*/ dbyangs kyi sgras 'di ltar gyer ro// hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā kā la che// dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// khyod la gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba// nag po ro langs dur khrod bdag /mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon// bsil ba'i tshal du mtshan gsol ba// nag po mna' gzan kun gyi gshed// mtshan nas 'bod do da tshur byon// sgrub pa po yi gnas mchog na// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i tshogs ni si li li// sha chen spos kyi dud sprin khyil li li// bhan+dha rus pa'i tshogs ni khra la la// a kar dud sogs spos ngad thul lu lu// mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshogs so da tshur byon// bh+yo/ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham dud sol ma// legs ldan nag po rje blon 'bangs gsum dang*// khyab 'jug dug gi spu gri ra hu la// zhing skyong chen po seng ge'i gdong pa can// bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga bstan mar bcas// bod skyong dbang mo rdo rje'i g.yu sgron ma// dpal gyi lha mo shan+ti ro gzan dang*// kun gyi bka' sdod dregs pa cig car dmar// chos srungs snyo kha'i klu btsan sna yon ma// rnal 'byor bdag gi srung ma 'jigs byed tshogs// pho brgyud mo brgyud 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pas/ mngon sum du mthong ba lta bur bsgom la/ sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bdud rtsi gtor bas dam bcas pa dran te phrin las ci bsgo ba bsgrub par bsam mo// de nas/ mchod rdzas hūm̐ las chos skyong bsrung ma thams cad dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin ma tshang ba med pa re res kyang nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ rnga sil dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ rak+ta skom du 'thung ba'i phyir// khrag sna stong gi yon chab 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/

spyan gzigs sha la mdzad pa'i phyir// sha sna stong gi me tog 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ tshil chen dri la snom pa'i phyir// gsur chen spos kyi dud sprin 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la dhū pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ srin po'i gdug pa 'joms pa'i phyir// zhun chen gsal ba'i mar me 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ nus pa mchog dang rab ldan phyir// bdud rtsi lnga yi dri chab 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir// snying sna stong gi zhal zas 'di// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir// rkang gling thod rnga cang te'u sogs// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// bka' sdod ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ mgon po la phul/ bh+yo/ lha min rnams dang dgra bgegs bsgral ba yi// snying khrag dang 'dres dug chu khol ma'i rgyun// rgya mtshor bskyil ba'i mi bzad ar+ghaṃ 'di// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dri med yid 'ong lha rdzas bzang po dang*// drag po'i chu dang rdo rje dri chur bcas// gdug pa'i dri ldang zhabs bkru 'di dag kyang*// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// nyams pa bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga ni// ri ltar spungs shing ut+pal cher 'dzings dug

/mthun pa'i me tog 'phreng ba ltar spel ba// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// sna tshogs spos mchog bsregs dang gsur chen gyi// dud sprin mkha' la 'khrigs pa dri zhim ngad// phyogs bcu'i mthar 'gro rdo rje bdug spos kyang*// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// tsan dan ga bur bsil mngar snying po dang*// sha khrag rus pa dgra bo'i mkhris zhag dug /byugs par sbyar ba'i mi bzad dri ldang chab// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bgrang yas ro dang bcud ldan zhal zas mchog /bzang zhing 'tshal ba ma tshang med pa rnams// srid pa'i 'dod dgu'i gtos dang mnyam spel ba// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// lha mi'i sil snyan rnga dang mi rkang dung*// dkrol 'bud brdung dang glu dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sgras// zhing rnams shig shig g.yo byed 'di dag kyang*// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// 'bru tshig g.yul du bsad pa'i zhun chen ni// ro ras gyis sbar snang byed 'bar ba'i me// ma lus mchog tu gsal ba'i sgron me 'di// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dgra bo'i sha chen sha sna ri ltar spungs// nyams pa'i snying chen snying sna srid gsum gtams// gdug pa'i dmar chen dmar sna rgya mtshor bskyil// zhing bcu'i klad chen klad sna stong gsum bkang*// rgyu chen 'phreng bar brtsegs pas mkha' khyab cing*// 'dod dgu'i yon tan rnams ni sprin bzhin gtibs// ba liṃ gtor ma'i tshogs ni skar ltar bkra// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// nam mkha' ltar yangs thod pa rdo rje'i snod// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyar rdo rje'i rdzas// mchog gi rgyal ba rdo rjes byin brlabs pa// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// lha mo la phul/ me tog gdug pa mar me dri chab dang*// zhal zas rol mo re re'ang kun bzang kyi// rnam thar las thon mchod pa'i 'phreng ba 'di// legs ldan rje blon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// mgon po bdud kyi spu gri la phul/

dza ya/ dam nyams dgra bo las ngan sdig can 'di'i// phyi yi dbang po rnam lnga mchod par 'bul gyi bzhes// nang gi don snying rnam lnga mchod par 'bul gyi bzhes// gsang ba'i bla tshe srog gsum mchod par 'bul gyi bzhes// sha khrag dmar dang tshil chen mchod par 'bul gyi bzhes// klad rus rkang mar mchod par 'bul gyi bzhes// dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe srog dbugs 'di// gza' bdud chen po 'khor bcas zhal du bstab// bzhes shig rol zhig dgongs shig khā raṃ khā hi/ khyab 'jug rā hu la la phul/ khyed la mchod par 'bul ba ni// bsad pa'i sha dang myos pa'i chang*// bsregs pa'i gsur dang btsos pa'i zhag /khur ba khrag dang lha ba rkang*// nang khrol glo snying mkhal mar bcas// mgon po seng gdong thugs dam bskang*// zhing skyong la phul/ bh+yo/ sngags dang ting nge 'dzin dang phyag rgya yis// ye shes lha yi bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa// kha dog dri ro phun tshogs gser skyems 'di// lha sman rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon rnams ji snyed pa// rnam bkra chen rin me tog char gyis bkang*// dri zhim bdug pa'i spos kyi sprin phung 'khrigs// nyi zla'i snang ba 'dzin pa'i sgron mas gtams// dri bzang chab kyi rgya mtsho rnam par 'khyil// lha yi bza' ba'i tshogs ni ri ltar spungs// snyan pa'i rol mo gnam sa 'bir byed cing*// ser g.yu mu tig phung po gcal du bkram// lha mi'i dkor nor ji snyed phyogs bcur bkod// gtsang ma'i mchod rdzas ma tshang med pa 'di// lha sman rgyal mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// mched lnga 'khor dang bcas la mchod par 'bul// tshe ring ma la phul/ dam tshig gtsang mar sbyar ba'i mchod pa 'di// rdo rje g.yu sgron ma la mchod par 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs rgyan gyi mchod pa bzhes// mchod par bzhes shig a la la ho/ g.yu sgron mar phul/

khyed dang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni// gdengs can gshos bu zur gsum la// gser skyems bdud rtsi phud kyis bran// le brgan ru mtshon mkha' la 'phyar// glang chen dmar po rol du 'dur// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol// cig car dmar por phul/ rol mo dang bcas pas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i nag po che// pad+ma'i nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs// gdug pa tshar gcod med dpung nang*// mthu chen khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐/ bya rog ming chen nag po che// zhal gcig phyag bzhi khro bo'i gzugs// zhabs gnyis gyad kyi stang stabs bzhugs// stobs chen khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐/ cha lugs 'chang ba'i nag po che// sbrul dang rin chen thod pas brgyan// stag lpags sham thabs sku la gsol// dpa' bo khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐/ 'phrin las mdzad pa'i nag po che// 'bras bu thod khrag zhal du gsol// gdug pa'i mtshon cha phyag na bsnams// gsod byed khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐/ gzi mdangs ldan pa'i nag po che// dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes// ag tshom smin ma me ltar 'bar// brjid pa khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐/ snying rje khros pa'i nag po che// spyan gsum sdang mig me ltar 'bar// rab tu 'khrug pa'i khro gnyer can// gtum chen khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i gzugs can nag po che// zhal gdangs drag po'i mche ba gtsigs// ljags 'dril nga ro hūm̐ sgra sgrog /za byed khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐/ byang chub sems ldan nag po che// sangs rgyas spyan sngar khas blangs pa// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes// dam can khyod la bdag bstod do// hūm̐/ dam las ma 'da' nag po che// bstan pa srungs shig nag po che// rnal 'byor skyongs shig nag po che// bka' bzhin sgrubs shig nag po che// gal te dam las 'das gyur na// dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs khros te// khyod nyid nyams par 'gyur ta re// rang nyid rlag par gyur ta re// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ bh+yo/ rgya mtsho'i klong nas me 'bar khyod// mtsho rnams skem par nus ma ste// bud med thams cad zhi mdzad phyir// lha chen sku yi phyed du bzhugs// rdzong dang bka' zlog nag mo che// lha dang lha min phyag byas ma// mi nad gang yin khyod ming shes// de la 'jigs pa med par 'gyur// gshin rje'i lcam mo bdud kyi yum// 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma// nad do cog gi bdag mo ste// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba yi// dpal ldan lha mo khyod la bstod// ces dud sol ma la bstod// hūm̐/ lha min dmag gi g.yul bzlog cing*// lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin pa// rdo rje dur khrod 'khor bcas la// dang ba'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bdud kyi spu gri la bstod/ hūm̐/ khyab 'jug chen po kun tu rgyu// 'jigs byed rog ti sprul pa'i sku// pha ni srin la ma ni klu// klu srin bsdongs pa'i mthu bo che// lus po gcig la mgo bo dgu// mgo lus thams cad mig gis gang*// sku mdog 'jigs pa'i dud kha bo// g.yas na chu srin zhags pa bsnams// g.yon na rwa'i mda' gzhu bsnams// sku stod srin la sku smad sbrul// sku stod nam mkha'i mthongs na bzhugs// sku smad rgya mtsho'i gting na bzhugs// gza' bdud chen po'i dus la bab// lho nub mtshams nas sku bzhengs la// zla ba'i rjes gcod shar du rgyu// byang shar mtshams nas sku bzhengs la// nyi ma'i rjes gcod nub tu rgyu// nyin mo rgyu ba mtshams bzhi 'joms// mtshan mo rgyu ba phyogs bzhi 'joms// bar snang khams su rgyu tsa na// 'jig rten khams kun 'khrug cing bsreg /lo nyes 'khrug pa rims nad gtong*// thog dang ser ba sa g.yos 'bebs// nyi ma zla ba lto ru za// sngon du su phrad khyur mid byed// 'jigs byed chen po mi bsrun pa// mig mang po la kha gdangs po// dus tshod tshes grangs kun gyi bdag

/lha 'dre kun gyi nad dpyad mkhan// 'byung ba lnga yi bdud po che// lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpon byed// steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu rgyu// ki kaṃ sna tshogs 'bebs pa'i bdag /'jig rten 'di na mthu che ba// drag rtsal khyod las che ba med// sangs rgyas snga rabs bstan pa la// 'jig rten phung byed drag shul can// phyag na rdo rje'i spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// sha rul khrag rul mchod par bzhes// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hrīḥ phyogs bzhi nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// sbas shing gab pa'i gdong mo bzhi rnams ni// shar nas stag srin zor ba'i gdong*// nam mkha'i dkyil nas 'brug gi sgra sgrog ma// lho nas baṃ srin dred mo'i gdong*// bar snang khams nas drag po'i glog 'gyu ma// nub nas kong srin ba lang gdong*// ri rab rtse nas gnam lcags thog 'bebs ma// byang nas 'brog srin chu srin gdong*// rgya mtsho'i gting nas khrag gi ser 'bebs ma// sring mo gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam dus la bab// rnal 'byor rgyud bskul bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// ces gza' la bstod/ hūm̐/ gzhan gyis mi thub dpa' bo che// rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu dang ldan// bzlog par dka' ba'i drag shul can// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' sdod khyod la bstod// ces zhing skyong la bstod/ nu ldan kun gyi gtso mo bcom ldan ma// phyi ltar dur khrod 'jig rten ḍā ki?'i tshul// nang ltar rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro dam tshig can// gsang bar rgyal ba dgyes mdzad yum chen lngas// bdag la 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin dang*// rigs rgyud dar zhing rgyas pa'i mchog sbyin ma// snang srid gsal ba 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang*// zas nor phyugs kyi 'gro ba cher 'phel ba'i// dngos grub stsal nas gsang chen lam bgrod pa'i// nyams rtogs ches cher 'phel ba'i grogs mdzad de// rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par byin gyis rlobs// rnam pa kun tu 'gal rkyen thams cad las// legs par bsrung zhing skyob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// ces tshe ring mched lnga'i bstod/

rgyal ba'i yum mchog rdo rje g.yu sgron ma// chos sku'i dbyings la spros pa mi mnga' yang*// longs sku rigs lnga ma dang mkha' 'gror ston// sprul sku sman mos 'gro don mdzad la bstod// ces g.yu sgron ma la bstod// dregs pa sde brgyad kun gyi mgon// dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang po yi// mched cig gnas chen bdag po ni// cig car dmar po khyod la bstod// spro na man ngag bzhin du bzlas// de nas/ tshogs kyi yo byad bshams/ chang gis bran nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥ sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ las nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa'i thod pa'i snod du/ āḥlas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas zhu zhing khol ba/ hūm̐ yig gi 'od kyis ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi bkug pa dang ro gcig tu bsres/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ de nas sgra brnyan dbyangs snyan po dang ldan pas bskang ba 'di lta bur gyer ro// hūm̐/ lha mi'i 'dod yon ma lus tshogs pa'i sprin// so so'i thugs la dgyes dgu'i char 'bebs pa// nam mkha'i khams rnams kun nas khyab pa 'dis// dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// g.yag lug rta khyi gcan gzan gtum po'i tshogs// bya nag rten gtor g.yang gzhi dpa' bo'i snying*// srog gi 'khor los bstems sogs rang rang gi /rten rdzas rgya cher spel bas thugs dam bskang*// sku brnyan rnga dang cang te'u sil snyan dung*// bong bu gwa dmar nal bu'i rgyal mtshan snying*// mdong mtha' can gyi gar dang 'dod yon lnga// dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ sbreng bas thugs dam bskang*// rin chen go cha rno ba'i dgra cha dang*// 'phyar ba'i dar dang bsra ba'i lag cha dang*// blta bas mi ngoms spyan gzigs dkor cha dbyig /gaṅgā'i zhing rdul grangs chas thugs dam bskang*// dri ro bcud mdangs phud kyi bza' btung ni// srid na ci mchis de snyed spungs pa gang*// sngags rgyas dam tshig rdzas su legs bsnyen pa'i// tshogs dang gtor ma rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang*// dgyes bzhin 'khor bar 'gal rkyen sel ba dang*// gnad du bskul bas 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i rgyu// mchod dang nye ba bsgrub pa'i sgom bzlas sogs// mthun pa'i dam tshig yongs kyi thugs dam bskang*// lcam dral khyed dang dam can ma lus par// mchog tu gdung shugs ldan kyang mi mkhas pas// tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i dam tshig las nyams pa// do nub bskang ngo bshags so thugs dam can// de ltar bskang zhing bshags nas 'dod pa'i don// ma lus bsgrub cing lhag par bdag cag la// pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa'i las brtsams pa// gang mchis dgra bgegs nyid la bzlog par mdzod// de nas/

tshogs phud gtor ma la grangs bzhin bran nas/ cha lnga la/ hūm̐/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'di// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*// ma hā kā la 'khor bcas dang*// dpal ldan dud sol 'khor dang bcas// mgon po rje blon 'bangs gsum dang*// khyab 'jug chen po 'khor bcas dang*// zhing skyong seng gdong yab yum dang*// tshe ring mched lnga bstan mar bcas// rdo rje g.yu sgron dpal lha dang*// gzhi bdag dge bsnyen mched gnyis sogs// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ zhes bsngos nas nam mkhar dor/ de nas gtor ma rnams chang gis bran nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ las nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa'i thod pa'i snod du/ āḥlas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas zhu zhing khol ba/ hūm̐ yig gi 'od kyis ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi bkug pa dang ro gcig tu bsres/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum mam bdun gyis mgon po la 'bul/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li hūm̐ bh+yo i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis lha mo la 'bul/ gzhan rnams la/ oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṝ da biṣ+ṇu rā hu lak+ṣe ṭa pā la/ maṃ laṃ aṃ tsaṃ taṃ pañtsa ḍā ki? badz+ra la la li li/ traka shad sid+dhi ya ma du dza/ nag po ti pa rā dza/ rā ṭiṭa ma ya dza dzaḥ shin+ti a ka ṭa bhak+ṣi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam/ yang na oṃ ā ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dhar+m+ma ṇāṃ a d+yā nut+pan+na tota oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bdun gyis thams cad la bsngo'o// de nas/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa lcam dral/

las kyi mgon po bya rog gi gdong pa can la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dud pa'i sol ba ma/ mgon po bdud kyi spu gri/ khyab 'jug gza'i spu gri/ zhing skyong tshe ring mched lnga/ rdo rje g.yu sgron/ bstan ma bcu gnyis/ cig car dmar po/ smyo kha'i klu btsan rdo rje sna yon ma la sogs pa'i/ dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bka' dang dam la btags pa'i dam can rgya mtsho/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag dang bcas pa rnams la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma phul bas/ dgyes rab kyi mchog mnyes rab kyi phul du gyur cig deng 'dir bdag la mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las bsrung ba dang*/ mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa'i mchog stsol bar mdzad du gsol lo// zhes brjod/ gtor ma hab dir gyis gsol bar bsam mo// tshogs la longs spyod de nas lhag bsdus kha phru btab/ oṃ u tsiṣ+ṇu bha ling+ta bhak+ṣaḥswā hās bsngos phyir dor// de nas dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa badz+ra mus rten la bsdu/ se gol gtogs/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /chos skyong srung ma 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan bsrung phyir// 'jigs byed mi bzad drag po'i lus dang ldan// rngam pa'i stobs kyis bdud bzhi tshar gcod pa'i// mgon po bya rog mtshan gyi bkra shis shog /zab mo rgyud kyi srung ma ma mo ni// zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub/ rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i// khrag 'thung dud sol lha mo'i bkra shis shog /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru// sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag rnams// bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sa skyong tshe dbang bsod nams dpal 'phel zhes// rgyal ba'i bstan srung skye bar mchod de yi// dran pa'i gsos su pad+ma dkar po ru// grags pa'i ba dan skyong ba des sbyar ro// 'dis kyang bstan pa dar bar gyur cig// /maṅga laṃ/// /
